description: “I’m Ziya from Grade 3B! I made an animated Canva story where a Mars rover explores the Red Planet, studies rocks and sends pictures back to Earth.”
summary: For the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Challenge 1: Abandoned but Not Forgotten: NASA’s Space Robots, Activity 2: Journey of a Space Robot), I made an animated Canva presentation called My Mars Rover: An Adventure on the Red Planet. In it, the rover tells its own story. It travels across the rocky surface of Mars on its wheels, studies rocks and soil, and sends pictures and scientific information back to Earth. My project helps us understand how space robots explore other planets.
details:
What does it do / how does it work?
My project is an animated story told by a Mars rover. The rover introduces itself as a robot explorer, then shows how it moves across Mars, studies rocks and soil, and sends pictures and information back to Earth.

What benefits does it have?
It helps children learn how space robots work and why they are important for exploring planets where people cannot go yet.

What is the intended impact?
I want children to feel curious about Mars and space robots, and to dream about exploring space one day: “Exploring Mars today, discovering tomorrow!”

What tools did you use?
I used Canva to make the animated presentation. I used text animations, transitions and space images of Mars and a rover.

How is it creative?
I let the rover tell its own story, using “I”, so it feels like the robot is talking to you. I used red Mars colours and moving text to make it feel like a real adventure.

What factors did I consider?

  • Real facts: I used true facts about what Mars rovers do: moving, studying rocks and sending information.
  • Simple words: Every child can understand the story.
  • Good pictures: The images and colours match the Red Planet.
  • Clear order: The rover introduces itself, explores, and then says thank you.
